/interface bridge add name=bridge-lan comment="LAN"
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether1 ] comment=WAN
/interface ethernet add name=ether2 comment="Uplink core"
/ip address add address=192.168.88.1/24 interface=bridge-lan
/interface vlan add interface=bridge-lan name=vlan100 vlan-id=100
/ip firewall filter add chain=input action=accept
/user add name=admin password=SuperSecret123
